import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { ExportImportDataService } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-erp-dashboard', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], template: `
Executive Business Intelligence

Dashboard & Reports Overview

High-level analytics across total imports, exports, vessel dispatches, country-wise trade lanes, and profit/loss margins.

Total Outbound Exports
{{ dataService.metrics().totalExportsFormatted }}
↑ 18% YoY Net Growth
Total Raw Material Imports
{{ dataService.metrics().totalImportsFormatted }}
Cotton & Dye Procurement
Pending Vessel Shipments
{{ dataService.metrics().pendingShipmentsCount }} TEU
En Route to Destination Ports
Arrived & Cleared Containers
{{ dataService.metrics().arrivedShipmentsCount }} TEU
Chattogram CGP & Depots

Country-wise Export Destinations

🇪🇺 European Union (Germany, Spain, UK)42%
🇺🇸 United States & Canada35%
🇦🇪 Middle East (UAE, KSA)13%

Supplier-wise Raw Material Import Allocation

Queensland Cotton Corp (Australia)56.0%
Uster Cotton Fiber Inc (USA)37.3%
Archroma Dyestuffs GmbH (Switzerland)24.7%
` }) export class ErpDashboardComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); }
